en:
Well, that just about covers it. You can try it out right
away, or if you prefer, you can have me explain again.
I'd like to play the game.
Very well. Then, without further delay...
Let's begin!

We'll need a great deal of money to complete our project.
Are you willing to contribute?
Really? Thank you very much! We're very grateful to you.

Our total investments have reached %s. How much would
you like to invest?

This should be enough to upgrade IF8 to the latest version
I've been working on.
And... done! IF8 has been upgraded to version 1.1!
The Kamurocho stage is now playable, thanks to the upgrade.
I hope you'll try it sometime.

Your cooperation is greatly appreciated. Total investments
now stand at %s.

Once we reach 100,000 yen, I'll be able to add a new stage
for you to play.
I hope you'll make the necessary investment.
And... done! IF8 has been upgraded to version 1.2!

Version 1.2 will allow you to earn Soul Orbs each time you
complete a stage.

But you will need to complete the same stage a number of
times. Give it a try!

Oh, and this is the final upgrade, so there's no need for
any more investments. Thank you for all of your help.
With 200,000 yen at hand, I could add new features.

Hm, broke, are you? Well, I'm far too busy to be dealing
with looky-loos. Good day.

So you're not going to contribute after all? Please don't
tease us, young lady.

I'm sorry, but no. I'm afraid I can't sign anything like
that... My apologies.
Oh, no!

Don't worry. She'll be back. What young lady doesn't dream
of becoming a magical heroine?
I'm not sure, but I hope you're right...

My dear, if you ever change your mind, please come on back
and see us any time. We will be here waiting for you.
Now then, are you ready to play?
Very well. Allow me to explain the particulars.

Defeat this boss, and you'll receive a boost to your own
abilities. Mind you, we're still gathering data, so only one
city is available at the moment.

You'll be able to play in other cities once we've gathered
enough data. Please be patient until then.

And one more thing. As I've mentioned, IF8 is still under
development. We need funding to complete our project.

Please consider contributing so that we might see this
device is fully completed. You see, I may not look it, but
I'm flat broke.

Of course, it would benefit you as well. Once the device is
finished, we'll be able to provide you with a wide variety
of feedback.
We certainly hope you'll give it some thought. Heheh.

Now then, one play is 10,000 yen. Quite a bargain, if you
ask me! However, we will allow you to play for free just
this once.
It looks like you cleared it! Congratulations!

You should now experience a boost to your own abilities.
Heheheh. You've given us some great data!

You're welcome to come back any time! We'll be here waiting
for you.
Thank you for your help. We hope to see you again!
You got 2,800 experience points.
Oh, what a pity. It looks like it's game over for you.

But you can always try again. We'll be here should you
decide to come back.

Heheheh. You're back! Decided you want to be a magical
heroine after all, have you?

If you'd like to play IF8, I'm afraid you'll have to sign
the non-disclosure agreement. Would you be all right with that?
Hmm. An agreement, huh?

Oh, please, miss! We beg you! You wouldn't believe how
difficult it is to find a lady who's willing to participate!
Reach 100,000 yen, and I'll be able to add a new stage.
With 500,000 yen at hand, I could add new features.
Hm? What do you want?
We're looking for someone to playtest our newly developed game system.
Please, won't you consider giving it a try?
No, please! Wait! This game is really quite amazing!
Aw, please, don't be like that!
It was developed by Doctor Minamida, the most brilliant scientist of our age. It's the latest version of Inner Fighter.
I'm Doctor Minamida's assistant.
Doctor Minamida...
We're calling the latest version Inner Fighter 8 Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
However, IF8 is not yet complete. We need people to actually play so we can get the data we need to complete it.
What do you say? Will you give it a try?
Okay, let me explain how to play.
IF8 allows you to play what we call "road battles" where you through a town fighting enemies until you reach their boss.
If you manage to beat the boss, you'll get an ability boost.
I only have data for one town right now, but we're busy collecting data we need, so not all the stages are playable yet.
Once we collect a little more data, you'll be able to play a bunch of different stages, though.
Oh, and as I mentioned before, IF8 isn't done yet. There are a lot of costs associated with completing it.
That's why we're hoping you'll invest in the machine's completion. Developing such a thing is an expensive endeavor, after all.
Of course, there's something in it for you, too. Once the machine's complete, it will be able to feed back a variety of data to you.

So please, think about it.
IF8 is a marvel of arcade machine technology. And it's the brainchild of the brilliant Doctor Minamida!
Did I mention it costs 10,000 yen to play a game? It's a little steep but well worth it.
Okay, now select the stage you want to play.
Okay, get ready for your road battle!
Oh, you really want to invest in IF8? You're a lifesaver!
Total investments so far have reached %s. How much will you invest?
I really hope you'll play it sometime. Well, see you again.
Thank you for your investment. Total investments have reached %s.
We need 100,000 yen to enable a new playable stage.
We'd really appreciate any amount you can afford to invest.
Your help is greatly appreciated. Total investments now stand at %s.
Please come again. I'll be waiting.
You don't want to invest in IF8? That's too bad.
Excuse me, sir. Do you have a moment?
Huh? You talkin' to me?
Ain't got time for that right now. You're gonna have to find someone else.
Doctor Minamida... That's the guy with that weird-ass machine under Kamurocho, right?
So you've heard of the doctor? Then you must know Inner Fighter is the real deal. Let me explain.
This is the latest version of Inner Fighter! We call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
That's what this is all about?
Exactly! We'd love for you to give it a try.
Like I said, I ain't got time right now.
Oh, well okay, then. I'll be here if you change your mind.
If you say so.
I hope to see you again soon!
IF8 allows you to play what we call "road battles" where you go through a town fighting enemies until you reach their boss.
That's why we're hoping you'll invest in the machine's completion. Developing such things is an expensive endeavor, after all.

So please, think about it, won't you?
IF8 is a marvel of arcade machine technology. And it's the brainchild of the brilliant Doctor Minamida!
I'm sorry, but I don't know much about games.
It's very easy to play even if you don't know a thing about video games.
Still not interested? Well, we'd really love to have a young lady like you take IF8 for a spin.
Haven't you ever wanted to be a magical girl who could cast spells and gracefully beat down hordes of attacking thugs?
Hmm... That does sound kind of fun, but...
Exactly! Who wouldn't want to do stuff like that? IF8 makes dreams like that come true.
And by playing, you'll be able to boost your idol abilities.
Wait, how did you know I'm an aspiring idol?
I never miss an airing of the Princess League. You're Haruka Sawamura-san right?
However, IF8 is not yet complete. We need people to actually play, so we can get the data we need to complete it.

So think about it, won't you?
IF8 is a marvel of arcade machine technology. And it's the brainchild of the brilliant Doctor Minamida!
You can try again whenever you want, though.
You earned one Soul Orb.
Heat Gauge capacity increased.
We call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
I'm Doctor Minamida's Assistant.
Right!? Who wouldn't want to do stuff like that? IF8 makes dreams like that come true.
I am.
Excuse me!
Hm? I'm kind of in a hurry here.
I promise it won't take too long. We're looking for someone to playtest our newly developed game machine.
No thanks. This doesn't pass the sniff test.
You've got the wrong idea! There's nothing fishy about it! It's called Inner Fighter.
It's an arcade machine developed by the brilliant scientist, Doctor Minamida. We're working on the latest version right now.
Doctor Minamida?
I think I've heard that name before. He's the one who has the massive game machine down under Kamurocho, right?
Exactly. That's Inner Fighter.
And this is the latest Inner Fighter! We call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
IF8 is a marvel of arcade machine technology, and it's the brainchild of the brilliant Doctor Minamida!
Excuse me, sir! Would you like to play IF8?
IF8?
Yes, IF8. We're looking for someone to playtest our newly developed game system.
What kind of game are we talking about here?
Here, let me tell you a little more about it.
IF8 is the latest version of Inner Fighter, an arcade machine developed by the brilliant Doctor Minamida.
IF8 is a marvel of arcade machine technology. And it's the brainchild of the brilliant Doctor Minamida!
This time, I'll offer you a prize.
Oh my! Kiryu-kun, is that you!?
Long time no see, Minamida.
Yes, far too long, indeed.
Is this what I think it is?
Hehe. I see I've piqued your interest.
This is the latest version of Inner Fighter, my epoch-making arcade machine.
I call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
So you're still working on it, eh? Some things never change.
The development of arcade machines is a never-ending endeavor.
Anyway, you could play right now if you'd like.
Ah, it's you.
Minamida. Sorry for giving you the runaround back in Nagasugai.
No need to hide your identity now?
That's right. So, you knew all along?
These old eyes aren't so easily deceived. But I could tell you had your reasons, so I didn't press the matter.
I appreciate that.
Don't you worry about it. As I said, you no doubt had your reasons.
That I did. Anyway, about IF8. Have you finished it yet?
I'm glad you asked. Development is going along nicely thanks to the data we've collected.
You could play right now if you'd like.
Saejima-kun? It's been ages since I've seen you.
Yeah, it's been a while, Minamida. Still workin' on your electric chair thing?
This is no electric chair! This is the latest version of Inner Fighter, my epoch-making arcade machine.
You ain't changed a bit.
IF8 is an incredible advancement in arcade machine technology.
Yeah, it's been a while, Minamida.
Ran into your assistant over in Tsukimino. Told me you were workin' on a new Inner Fighter.
So I take you're up to speed, then?
You could play right now if you'd like, you know.
Can I help you, my dear?
Oh, no. Never mind. Sorry to bother you.
I wonder what this giant machine is.
Has my IF8 caught your eye, young lady?
Oh, hello there.
Say, didn't we meet over in Sotenbori?
Minamida-san, was it? So, what is this here?
This is the latest version of Inner Fighter. More precisely, it's the main unit of Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle.
It's the same game you played in Sotenbori.
Isn't this that Inner Fighter game machine? Didn't know it was still down here.
I was hoping I might see you again, Akiyama-kun.
Minamida, was it? Long time no see. Still tinkering with your machine?
But this looks just like the machine I saw last time.
On the outside, yes, but on the inside, it's a completely different beast.
This is the latest version of Inner Fighter! I call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
Right... It was IF7 last time.
IF8 is my epoch-making advance in arcade machine technology.
Hey, long time no see.
Oh, Akiyama-kun! I was hoping I might run into you again.
Your assistant told me you were still working on Inner Fighter.
So you've met with my assistant, have you? I take it you're up to speed, then?
I'd expect nothing less from you.
What's with the creepy machine?
Creepy? I'll have you know this is a marvel of modern science!
You're kind of creepy, too. What're you doing down here, anyway?
First of all, my name is Minamida, and I'm conducting research here.
And this is my arcade machine that I've been working on for many years.
